title: Novel Object Recognition test analysis 
developed by: Narendra Solanki (NS)

This script takes the preprocessed data from the PREPROCESSOR.R 
script and returns plots and statistical analysis as an RmD.
It can be run by itself, or used as an R child. 


INPUT DATA       : Output from PREPROCESS.R (.xlsx file)
                   lookup file (.xlsx)
             
CURRENT SETTINGS : ONLY TESTED FOR THE X PROJECT!!!
                   1 Cohorts 
                   3 strains
                   > This means that the script is currently able to analyze a 
                   project consisting of the settings above. For all other 
                   settings the scripts needs to be adjusted accordingly


SECTIONS         :# 1.MANUAL ENTRIES
                    - In this section adjustments can be made regarding:
                        > Input file
                        > Experimental settings
                        > plots (color, theme etc.)
                        
                  
                  # 2. LOAD DATA:
                    - loads the preprocessed data and tidies it up into a polished "data" data frame
                  
                  # 3. ANALYSIS
                    3.1 Duration of Interaction
                    3.2 Discrimination ratio or preference for the unfamiliar
                    3.3 Sample phase
                    
                    For each section a plot and a statistical analysis is performed
                  
                  # 4. Final conclusions and comments



NOTES             : - This script has been tested on the Project 'X'. 
                      Variations in the zone naming may lead to errors
                      > if this occurs there are two options:
                          1. Rerun the preprocessor and use the zone names as in the above project
                            
                             OR
                             
                          2. Replace the column references in this script for the analysis
                    
                    - Make sure that the zones in Cohort 1 and Cohort 2 (if available) are named identically otherwise the merging step will not be able to find the matching zones
                      (this can be adjusted in the Preprocessing)

## Novel Object Recognition Test

-- **Duration -  []**   
-- **Parameters\:**   

-- **Illustration:**  
Boxplots and individual scores  

```{r data_loading}

# Empty global environment
rm(list = ls())

#--------------------------- 1. Manual Entries -----------------------------#
# 1.1 INPUT FILES 
#IMPORTANT: Please also check the renaming of the columns in 'LOAD DATA' !!!!!!
file_path <- "~/6. Data from Behavioral Tests/NOR/data/"

raw_data_file_c1 <- "Cohort 1_2025-07-25.xlsx"
raw_data_file_c2 <- "Cohort 2_2025-07-25.xlsx"

# 1.2 PLOT
#here we define the colors we going to use for the different strains in the plots
#color_flu <- c('#0099CC', '#FF9900', '#DC143C', '#8B008B')


#---------------------------2. LOAD DATA-----------------------------#
# Load data
data_c1 <- read_excel(paste(file_path,raw_data_file_c1,sep=""))
data_c2 <- read_excel(paste(file_path,raw_data_file_c2,sep=""))

# combine all groups to create a single data frame 
raw_data <- rbind(data_c1, data_c2)
#raw_data <- raw_data %>% 
#  mutate("ID" = as.numeric("ID"))

#raw_data <- transform(raw_data,"ID"=as.numeric("ID"))

# lookup
file_path_lookup <- "~/6. Data from Behavioral Tests/"

# load lookup data files
lookup_file <- "lookup.xlsx"

# read lookup data files
lookup <- read_excel(paste(file_path_lookup,lookup_file,sep=""))
names(lookup)[names(lookup) == 'Animal ID'] <- 'ID'

lookup <- lookup %>%
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID))

# combine data with lookup
data_NOR <- full_join(raw_data,lookup, by= c("ID", "cohort"))

#get list of strains without NAs
list_of_groups <- sort(na.omit(unique(data_NOR$Group)), decreasing = T)
  
data <- data_NOR %>%
  dplyr::select(no, ID, cohort, Group, Sex, contains("Tracklength"), contains("Track_length"), contains("Visits"), contains("Visit"), contains("Duration"), phase) %>% 
  # Factor the genotype/group variable
  mutate(group = factor(Group, levels = list_of_groups),
         Cohort = as.factor(cohort),
         gender = as.factor(Sex))  # otherwise ggplot raises an error
  

## SELECT SUM ROWS AND THEN PERFORM CALCULATIONS BELOW
## or Perform calculations as it is and then plot with sum 

# Extract data from novel phase
data_nov = data %>%
  filter(no == "Sum",
         phase == "novel") %>%
  # Calculate percentage of time spent at novel object and store it in a new column
  mutate(
    perc_time_center = (`Duration_(s)_spiky_ball`/(`Duration_(s)_spiky_ball` + `Duration_(s)_block`)) * 100) %>%
  # Calculate discrimination ratio and store it in a new column
  mutate(
    dis_ratio_nov = ((`Duration_(s)_spiky_ball` - `Duration_(s)_block`)/(`Duration_(s)_spiky_ball` + `Duration_(s)_block`))
)

# Extract data from sample phase
data_sample = data %>%
  filter(no == "Sum",
         phase == "sample") %>%
  # Calculate percentage of time spent at right block and store it in a new column
  mutate(
    perc_time_samp = (`Duration_(s)_block_2`/(`Duration_(s)_block_2` + `Duration_(s)_block_1`)) * 100) %>% 
  # Calculate discrimination ratio and store it in a new column
  mutate(
    dis_ratio_sample = ((`Duration_(s)_block_2` - `Duration_(s)_block_1`)/(`Duration_(s)_block_2` + `Duration_(s)_block_1`))
)
  
```

### Results

#### Novel phase

##### Percent of time spent at novel object

```{r fig1, fig.align = "left", fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4}

#---------------------------3. ANALYSIS-----------------------------#
# 3.1 NOR test, phase 2: New OBJECT PHASE 
# 3.1.1 Percent of time spent at novel object

# stats fig1a
stat_1a <- data_nov %>%
  wilcox_test(perc_time_center ~ group,exact=FALSE) %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%     #  p.signif
  add_xy_position(x = "group") 

# plot fig1a
pl_1a <- data_nov %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = perc_time_center, color = group, label ="")) +
  geom_boxplot() +  
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.05), aes(shape = Cohort), size = 2) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(18,90)) +    
  #remove filling (length of values needs to be equal to number of cohorts)
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,2)) + 
  labs(x="", y = "Exploration time at novel object (%)", title = "NOR (2) phase") +
  theme_pubr() + 
  stat_n_text() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_1a, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#pl_1a

################################# 
# stats fig1b
stat_1b <- data_nov %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  wilcox_test(perc_time_center ~ gender,exact=FALSE) %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "group")

# plot fig1b
pl_1b <- data_nov %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = perc_time_center, color = gender, label ="")) +
  geom_boxplot() +  
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.05), aes(shape = Cohort), size = 2) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(18,90)) +   
  #remove filling (length of values needs to be equal to number of cohorts)
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,2)) + 
  labs(x="", y = "Exploration time at novel object (%)", title = "NOR (2) phase") +
  theme_pubr() + 
  stat_n_text() + 
  geom_text(aes(y = after_stat(count), label=after_stat(count)), stat="count", y=18, position = position_dodge(width = 0.95,), size=4, show.legend = FALSE) +    
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_1b, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#pl_1b

# Create a grid with plots
fig1 <- ggarrange(pl_1a, pl_1b, 
                               ncol = 2, nrow = 1,
                               common.legend = FALSE, legend = "bottom", labels = c("A", "B"))

fig1

```

__Figure 1.__ Comparison of percent of time spent exploring objects during 
novel phase between groups (A) and between gender within group (B).

__Statistics for Figure 1 A (between groups)__

```{r stat1a, echo=F}

#create a tibble to collect all stats

stat_1a %>%
  dplyr::select(-y.position,-groups,-xmin,-xmax) %>%
  #remove horizontal lines between rows
  kable(booktabs = T) %>%
  #prevent table from floating and scale it to page-width
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position","scale_down"))

```

```{r stat1b, echo=F}

  #remove horizontal lines between rows
```

##### Comparision of time spent exploring objects during novel phase

```{r fig4, fig.align = "left", fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4}

# 3.1.4 Comparison of time spent exploring novel and non-novel object during novel 
# -phase between genotypes. 

# data fig4
data_pl4 <- data_nov %>%
  mutate(spiky = `Duration_(s)_spiky_ball`,
         block = `Duration_(s)_block`) %>%
  select(spiky, block, group, no, Cohort, gender) %>%  
#  select(`Duration_(s)_spiky_ball`, `Duration_(s)_block`, group, no, Cohort, gender) %>%
  gather(key = "Side", value = "Dur", -group, -no, -Cohort, -gender) #%>%

# stats fig4a
stat_4a <- data_pl4 %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
#  wilcox_test(Dur ~ Side, exact = FALSE) %>%  
  wilcox_test(Dur ~ Side, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE) %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "group")

# plot fig4a
pl_4a <- data_pl4 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = Dur, color = Side, label ="")) +
  geom_boxplot() +  
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.05), aes(shape = Cohort), size = 2) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-5,60)) +     
  #remove filling (length of values needs to be equal to number of cohorts)
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,2)) + 
  labs(x="", y = "Duration of time (s)", title = "Time spent exploring during novel phase") +
  theme_pubr() + 
  stat_n_text() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_4a, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#pl_4a
    
################################# 
# stats fig4b
stat_4b <- data_pl4 %>%
  group_by(group,Side) %>%
  wilcox_test(Dur ~ gender, exact = FALSE) %>%    
  add_significance("p") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "Side")

# plot fig4b    
pl_4b <- data_pl4 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Side, y = Dur, color = gender, label ="")) +
  facet_grid (~group) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.05), aes(shape = Cohort), size = 2) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-5,60)) +    
  #remove filling (length of values needs to be equal to number of cohorts)
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,2)) + 
  labs(x="", y = "Duration of time (s)", title = "Time spent exploring during novel phase") +
  theme_pubr() + 
  stat_n_text() +  
  geom_text(aes(y = after_stat(count), label=after_stat(count)), stat="count", y=-6, position = position_dodge(width = 0.95,), size=4, show.legend = FALSE) +    
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_4b, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)  
  
#pl_4b

# Create a grid with plots
fig4 <- ggarrange(pl_4a, pl_4b, 
                               ncol = 2, nrow = 1,
                               common.legend = FALSE, legend = "bottom", labels = c("A", "B"))

fig4

```

```{r fig5, fig.align = "left", fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4}
# 3.2 NOR test, phase 1: SAMPLE PHASE

  mutate(left = `Duration_(s)_block_1`,
         right = `Duration_(s)_block_2`) %>%
  select(left, right, group, no, Cohort, gender) %>%  
#  select(`Duration_(s)_spiky_ball`, `Duration_(s)_block`, group, no, Cohort, gender) %>%
  gather(key = "Side", value = "Dur", -group, -no, -Cohort, -gender) #%>%

# stats fig5a

  group_by(group) %>%
#  wilcox_test(Dur ~ Side, exact = FALSE) %>%

  add_significance("p") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "group")

# plot fig5a

  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = Dur, color = Side, label ="")) +
  geom_boxplot() +  
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.05), aes(shape = Cohort), size = 2) +

  #remove filling (length of values needs to be equal to number of cohorts)
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,2)) + 
  labs(x="", y = "Duration of time (s)", title = "Time spent exploring during sample phase") +
  theme_pubr() + 
  stat_n_text() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_5a, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#pl_5a

################################# 
# stats fig5b

  group_by(group,Side) %>% 
  wilcox_test(Dur ~ gender, exact = FALSE) %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "Side")

# plot fig5b
pl_5b <- data_pl5 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Side, y = Dur, color = gender, label ="")) +
  facet_grid (~group) +  
  geom_boxplot() +  
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.05), aes(shape = Cohort), size = 2) +
#  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-5,60)) +     
  #remove filling (length of values needs to be equal to number of cohorts)
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,2)) + 
  labs(x="", y = "Duration of time (s)", title = "Time spent exploring during sample phase") +
  theme_pubr() + 
  stat_n_text() + 
  geom_text(aes(y = after_stat(count), label=after_stat(count)), stat="count", y=0, position = position_dodge(width = 0.95,), size=4, show.legend = FALSE) +      
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_5b, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#pl_5b

# Create a grid with plots
fig5 <- ggarrange(pl_5a, pl_5b, 
                               ncol = 2, nrow = 1,
                               common.legend = FALSE, legend = "bottom", labels = c("A", "B"))

fig5

```

__Figure 5.__ Comparison of time spent exploring object 1 and object 2 during 
sample phase between groups (A) and between gender within group (B).
